### Modern Code

[Code + usage in ONE block per language:
- Language, stdlib, and first-party frameworks only — no 3rd-party packages.
- First line is a comment naming the minimum version + feature, e.g. `# Python 3.12+ — closures, type alias`.
- Separate definitions from usage with `# --- Usage ---` / `// --- Usage ---` (Dart: put it above `void main()`; Rust: above `fn main()`).
- Rust: first line like `// Rust 1.85+ (edition 2024) — closures, impl Fn`. Code must pass clippy with warnings denied (`clippy::new_without_default` is allowed).
- Each block must run as-is as a complete program; expected output goes in comments, identical across languages. Check with `just verify <chapter.qmd>`.
